absent-from-2014.flag: its whole text is not in the 2014 transcription
absent-from-2014.answer: 2014 line 15032 has the same rule with a '## Page 375' marker before d): page break only. Re-read §2002:13.16.36.3 GR10 (FORMAT 3, report-writer): unchanged.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines report as 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 drops the definition and describes reports through the REPORT clause and RD (§2023:13.18.46.1). Same object in both: what GR10 governs (repetitions in a report group) does not change.

communication-reach.flag: clause 13.16.36 is reached by the 2002 communication section (Annex A, the CD entry)
communication-reach.answer: No reach: GR10 is banded FORMAT 3, the report-writer OCCURS, and speaks of 'report items' in a 'report group definition'; a CD entry cannot hold a report group description entry, so no communication-section entry is governed.
